Notes
Full-Time and Part-Time Spa Therapists

Exciting opportunities have arisen for qualified Therapists to join our professional wellness and holistic Therapist Team at Brightlife Spa.

As we prepare to open our new Spa Garden and welcome more guests, we are expanding our team and are seeking both full-time and part-time therapists who share our commitment to exceptional treatments, outstanding guest care and holistic well-being.

Our Spa offers a range of indulgent treatments and wellness facilities within a serene and tranquil setting. Our therapies take a holistic approach, focusing on each guest as an individual and supporting their overall physical, mental and emotional well-being. We aim to provide every guest with a deeply relaxing, personalised and memorable experience.

The Role
As a Spa Therapist, you will play an important role in delivering exceptional treatments and ensuring the comfort and well-being of our guests throughout their visit.
Your responsibilities will include:
Performing a variety of spa treatments, including massage, facials, body treatments and other holistic wellness therapies.
Assessing each guest’s individual needs and tailoring treatments accordingly.
Providing knowledgeable and appropriate treatment and aftercare recommendations.
Delivering consistently high standards of guest care and professionalism.
Maintaining excellent standards of hygiene, cleanliness and presentation within treatment rooms and communal areas.
Working collaboratively with other members of the spa team to create a harmonious and efficient working environment.

Full training will be provided in our complete range of treatments and treatment protocols.

Qualifications and Attributes
Applicants should:
Hold an NVQ Level 3 qualification, or equivalent, in beauty therapy and massage.
Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate a genuine interest in holistic therapies, wellness and guest care.
Be able to work confidently both independently and as part of a team.
Have a positive, friendly and professional manner.
Be reliable, well-presented and committed to maintaining high standards.

What We Offer
Full in-house training in our treatment range and protocols.
Full uniform.
Competitive rates of pay.
A beautiful and supportive working environment.
The opportunity to become part of an established spa as it enters an exciting period of growth.

Both full-time and part-time positions are available. Working hours will include a combination of daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

How to Apply
To apply, please email your CV and a covering letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience to julie.watson@brightlife.com.

We’re hiring: Cleaner & Housekeeping Assistant – The Earl of Derby
We’re looking for a reliable, hardworking and detail-focused Cleaner & Housekeeping assistant to help maintain our premises to the highest standard.
You’ll need to be: organised, thorough, self-motivated and take pride in creating immaculate spaces; someone who notices the little details and enjoys delivering an exceptional guest experience. The role is active and hands-on, involving regular manual handling, carrying laundry and supplies, and working across multiple floors using stairs.
The main aspect of the role covers maintaining our public areas and supporting the smooth day-to-day operation with early morning shifts. Additional duties include the daily checks and turnovers of suites and replenishing amenities. The role can be made flexible for the right candidate.
A brilliant opportunity for someone who values high standards and wants to be part of a quality island venue.
To apply or find out more, please get in touch. Please email your CV and covering letter to hello@earlofderby.im

We are looking for an experienced Contracts and Compliance Manager to oversee the commercial and contractual performance of our facilities management and building services contracts.

The role will be responsible for managing the full contract lifecycle, including renewals, extensions, variations and annual price reviews, while ensuring contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs and payment terms are effectively managed. You will monitor contract profitability, identify areas of commercial risk and ensure scope creep and additional works are appropriately identified, quoted and charged.

You will also oversee PPM delivery and maintenance compliance, ensuring schedules remain aligned with client contracts, asset registers, SFG20 and relevant statutory requirements. This will include monitoring overdue or at-risk PPMs, maintaining accurate records and ensuring appropriate certification and evidence is available to demonstrate compliance.

Working closely with Helpdesk, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Projects and QHSE teams, you will provide clear reporting to management, support client reviews and mobilisations, and identify risks or underperformance, driving appropriate corrective action.

About You

You will have experience within Facilities Management, Building Services or a similar contracted service environment, with strong commercial awareness and an understanding of contract profitability. You will have good knowledge of PPM delivery and maintenance compliance, with experience of SFG20 being advantageous.

Strong organisational, analytical and communication skills are essential, together with the confidence to challenge performance, identify risks and drive improvements.
Find Out More

For more information about Prospero, including our employee benefits and what we can offer you, please visit www.prospero.im.

Notes
The Site Manager will be responsible for overseeing projects from mobilisation through to completion, ensuring works are delivered safely, on programme and to the required standards of quality and workmanship. The role will involve coordinating site activities, subcontractors, suppliers and internal teams, managing site logistics and sequencing, conducting regular inspections and identifying and resolving risks or issues.

You will lead, motivate and support site teams and subcontractors, promoting a positive safety and performance culture while monitoring standards and identifying training and development needs. The role will also involve maintaining effective communication with clients, contractors and other stakeholders, ensuring project records are accurate and contractual, quality and regulatory requirements are met.

A key responsibility will be maintaining high standards of Health & Safety and compliance, including reviewing RAMS and permit-to-work documentation, supporting site audits and investigating incidents, near misses and non-conformances, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are implemented.

About You

You will have demonstrable experience in a Site Management role, ideally within construction, facilities management, maintenance or an M&E environment. A strong interest in Mechanical & Electrical services, together with a willingness to develop your technical knowledge, would be advantageous.

You will have excellent organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities across live projects. A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making is essential, together with the ability to work independently and recognise when issues need to be escalated.

Qualifications

A full Isle of Man or UK driving licence and IOSH Managing Safely certification are essential, along with a good understanding of Isle of Man health and safety requirements and construction regulations.

SMSTS/SSSTS, First Aid at Work, a CSCS Manager/Supervisor Card, and relevant construction, civil engineering or building services qualifications (NVQ, HNC/HND, Degree or equivalent) are desirable. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is also advantageous.

For more information about Prospero, including our employee benefits and what we can offer you, please visit www.prospero.im.
Interested?  Please send your CV to hr@prospero.im

At MannBenham, you won’t be lost in the background. You’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative team where your contribution matters.

There is scope to develop your own client-base and profile from our modern town centre office in Douglas, working within our supportive and professional working environment.
Applications are welcomed from qualified Advocates and Solicitors eligible for admission as Isle of Man Advocates.
To apply in confidence, please send your CV and a brief covering letter to hr@mannbenham.com.

Notes
The role of an AML Compliance Officer, reporting into the Group Money Laundering Reporting Officer, is critical in supporting the day-to-day compliance tasks across all Group companies, as outlined in the AML/CFT/CFP and Sanctions policies and procedures. This position involves active contributions to the AML Compliance Team's daily activities, ensuring alignment with the overarching objectives of the Group Risk and Compliance Department. Key responsibilities include conducting regular AML compliance monitoring in accordance with the Group Compliance Assurance Monitoring Framework and analysing the results to recommend necessary operational changes. The officer will assist in preparing and delivering AML training, conducting checks on sanctions lists, and investigating AML breaches. Additional duties comprise maintaining appropriate Group Registers and providing guidance to staff, while also supporting ad hoc project work as required. This role further involves assisting the MLRO during regulatory inspections and ensuring a robust AML framework that guides organisational behaviour, informs business decision-making, and bolsters comprehensive compliance across the Group. Please email team@itchyfeet.im or follow the link for further information and for details on how to apply https://itchyfeetoffshore.com/jobs/37438-aml-compliance-officer-isle-of-man/

Notes
LVW Law Limited is seeking a Legal Research Assistant to join our busy and friendly legal practice in Port Erin.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong interest in law who enjoys research, analysing information and producing clear, accurate written work.

The successful candidate will provide research support to the firm and its lawyers across a range of legal matters. Duties will include:

Conducting legal research across a variety of areas of law;
Researching Isle of Man legislation, Rules of Court, case law and other legal authorities;
Assisting with the preparation of legal arguments, opinions, correspondence and Court documents;
Reviewing and summarising legislation, judgments and other legal materials;
Identifying relevant authorities and presenting research findings clearly and concisely;
Assisting with the preparation of case files, bundles and other legal documentation;
Keeping up to date with developments in legislation, case law and legal procedure;
Providing general support to the legal team as required.

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities;
An excellent researcher with strong attention to detail;
Confident reading and interpreting legal material;
Able to analyse information and identify the key issues;
A strong written and verbal communicator;
Comfortable working independently while also being part of a team;
Discreet and professional when dealing with confidential information;
IT literate and able to learn and use legal research and case management systems.

A law degree, legal qualification or previous experience within a legal environment would be advantageous, although applications from candidates with relevant research, academic or professional experience will also be considered.

To apply, please send your CV together with a covering letter outlining your experience to stacey@lvwlaw.com

Notes
One Island Taxi is growing, and we're looking for licensed Taxi and Private Hire drivers across the Isle of Man to join our expanding driver network.

Following our public launch, we're already seeing bookings across Douglas and increasing demand in the South, West and North of the Island. We're looking for additional licensed drivers to help us improve coverage Island-wide.

One Island gives drivers an additional source of bookings while allowing them to retain their independence and flexibility. There is no monthly subscription, no joining fee and no exclusivity. You decide when you're available and only pay commission on bookings generated through One Island.

Introductory commercial model:

Month 1: 0% commission.
Month 2: 5% commission.
Month 3 onwards: 10% on the first £4,400 of monthly One Island earnings, reducing to 5% above £4,400.

You can continue working independently or with an existing Taxi or Private Hire operator. One Island simply provides another way for customers to find and book you when you're available.

You'll need to hold the appropriate current Isle of Man licences and documentation to join.

Interested in finding out more? Contact Ian Killey, Co-Founder & Head of Taxi Operations at One Island, to discuss joining the platform.

One Island gives drivers an additional source of bookings while allowing them to retain their independence and flexibility. There is no monthly subscription, no joining fee and no exclusivity. You decide when you're available and only pay commission on bookings generated through One Island.

Introductory commercial model:

Month 1: 0% commission.
Month 2: 5% commission.
Month 3 onwards: 10% on the first £4,400 of monthly One Island earnings, reducing to 5% above £4,400.

You can continue working independently or with an existing Taxi or Private Hire operator. One Island simply provides another way for customers to find and book you when you're available.

You'll need to hold the appropriate current Isle of Man licences and documentation to join.

Interested in finding out more? Contact Ian Killey, Co-Founder & Head of Taxi Operations at One Island, to discuss joining the platform. 	
ian.k@oneisland.im or 07624 488344.

Level 3 Practitioner – Dragonflies Nursery, Ramsey
We're looking for an enthusiastic Level 3 Early Years practitioner to join our team at Dragonflies Nursery in the heart of Ramsey. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a growing, purpose-built setting dedicated to creating a nurturing and enriching environment for children.
The ideal candidate will hold a Level 3 qualification in Early Years Education, have a genuine passion for working with young children, and bring a reliable, positive attitude to everything they do.
In return, we offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience, real opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive team who care deeply about the children in their care. You'll be joining a setting that's going from strength to strength, where your contribution genuinely matters.
To apply, send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you'd be a great fit. If you haven't heard back within two weeks, please assume your application was unsuccessful. All offers are subject to DBS and relevant security checks.
We can't wait to hear from you.

For more information and to apply please contact shondelle@grasshoppers.im

Notes
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Assistant Manager (Electrical) to support the Head of Electrical Services & Projects, in the strategic leadership, management and development of the Council’s Electrical Services Department.

This is a key role with responsibility for the safe, efficient and effective delivery of the Council’s public lighting services, electrical infrastructure, decorative lighting and associated electrical assets.  You will provide professional and technical advice on street lighting policy, asset management, resource planning and service delivery, ensuring compliance with statutory obligations, industry standards and highway requirements.  

You will co-ordinate a multidisciplinary operational workforce across electrical, civil engineering, blacksmith and painting services.  The role will oversee planned and reactive maintenance, capital projects, emergency response, technical compliance, asset renewal and service improvement programmes.  

You must have a Level 4 City & Guilds Higher Professional Diploma/HND or equivalent, in a relevant discipline and a proven track record of successful professional and managerial experience.  Strong interpersonal, stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with experience of managing financial budgets, is essential.  Membership of, or relevant registration with, the National Inspection Council for Electrical Installation Contractors (NICEIC) is also required.  Comprehensive knowledge and practical understanding of the following are also essential:

BS 5489: Design of Road Lighting / ENA Engineering Recommendation G39/1: Public Lighting Mandate / Public Lighting Central Management Systems (CMS) / Smart City LoRaWAN™ networks.

You must be proficient in the use of ICT applications and hold a current valid driving licence.

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Council’s website.  For an informal chat about the role please contact Andy Butterworth, Head of Electrical Services & Projects, abutterworth@douglas.gov.im.  Alternatively, you can contact HR on (696455). 

The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is Sunday, 13th September 2026.

Miss K J Rice, Chief Executive, City Hall, Ridgeway Street, Douglas, Isle of Man, IM99 1A

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team. The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Join our Network Services team as a Records & Drawing Office Technician, where you'll play a key role in maintaining accurate electricity network records and supporting the safe, reliable delivery of power to our customers. Using GIS, GPS surveying equipment and AutoCAD, you'll survey and record new network assets, update and manage network records, prepare outage notifications, review planning applications and produce technical drawings and scheme documentation. You'll work closely with engineers, contractors and other departments to ensure our network information remains accurate, compliant and up to date.

We're looking for a proactive and detail-focused individual with strong IT skills, experience of GIS and AutoCAD systems, and the ability to manage their own workload while working collaboratively as part of a team. You'll be committed to high standards of customer service, health and safety, continuous improvement and data accuracy. If you enjoy a varied role that combines office-based technical work with site visits and field surveying, and are keen to develop your knowledge of the electricity network, we'd love to hear from you. A full driving licence is essential.

Swagelok Ltd.
Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.
The roll can be physical demanding and an applicant must be capable of being on their feet for up to 8- hours a day. Lift, push, pull or carry weight no more than 35lbs, as well as squat bend and reach.
This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.
If you are interested in applying for this role, please visit our online portal at http://iomjobs.Swagelok.com

We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout. You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. 
The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. 
In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role. 
We are looking for a degree-educated professional who holds a recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or ICAS, and has demonstrable experience managing insolvency and advisory cases. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of insolvency legislation and procedures, coupled with excellent report-writing and communication skills. They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential. You can apply to the role using this link: https://smrtr.io/zZV-x

To drive and scale strategic enablement from Offshore centres into Africa, aligning offshore capabilities with the needs of African commercial clients. This role ensures the seamless integration of the Africa-Offshore value proposition, enabling agile teams, enhancing client experience, and promoting sustainable growth through collaboration with offshore-based stakeholders
Lead the execution of Africa-focused strategic initiatives from Offshore centres, ensuring offshore capabilities are aligned to the commercial priorities, growth ambitions, and client needs of African markets.
Develop and champion the Africa-Offshore strategic enablement framework, creating a consistent operating model, governance structure, and communication approach that embeds offshore capabilities across African client value chains.
Provide strategic advisory to Offshore and African stakeholders on market opportunities, regulatory considerations, and operating models that optimise client outcomes while maintaining compliance across offshore jurisdictions.
Strengthen collaboration between African and Offshore business units, fostering alignment across Coverage, Product, Operations and Support teams to accelerate execution of strategic initiatives and improve delivery to clients.
Embed Africa-specific client insights into Offshore propositions, ensuring products, services and engagement models reflect the unique commercial, regulatory and operational dynamics of African markets.
Drive the integration of Offshore capabilities into African client journeys, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships, unlock cross-border solutions, and increase commercial value for clients operating across jurisdictions.
Influence strategic investment and prioritisation decisions by evaluating opportunities across African markets and recommending initiatives that maximise client impact, revenue growth and long-term sustainability.
Monitor and evaluate the performance of Africa-originated offshore business, using data and commercial insights to identify trends, measure strategic outcomes, and recommend continuous improvements to enhance business performance.
Act as the central strategic liaison between Africa and Offshore centres, ensuring alignment of priorities, effective stakeholder engagement, and successful execution of cross-border initiatives.
Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, enhance the client experience, and strengthen Offshore value proposition to African commercial clients.

The role: 
The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will provide support for the Markets and Marketing function as well as the wider CDs firm. The ideal candidate should be diligent and well-versed running social media campaign and assisting in maintaining and updating the Crown Dependencies website. The candidate should also be familiar with design software, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign. The person should have the ability to plan, execute and manage timelines excellently. The role will require communication to stakeholders at all levels.

Accountabilities:
Support the team with campaign production and execution where needed, from global thought leadership to local events.
Create emails to be distributed internally and externally.
General administration which might include helping event suppliers with invoices, managing the job tracker, managing data into our CRM system, manage email queries regarding events.
Assist with eMarketing, including use of our CRM system and sending emails externally.
Maintain and update the local Crown Dependencies website. This includes liaising with other departments to ensure that the information included is accurate to the services they provide.
Act as creative lead for the marketing team – includes overseeing design work done by other members of the team and ensure brand guideline compliance.
Creating and scheduling social media content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts that are in line with our brand guidelines and in terms of imagery and tone of voice.
Develop and manage social media campaigns, both organic and paid.
Efficiently analyse the performance of both social media and the website to inform decision-making of future digital marketing activities.
Provide training to other departments within the firm to ensure brand compliance of documents that are sent to clients / external stakeholders.
Other marketing tasks may be included as the candidate becomes familiar with the working environment and team.

Candidate requirements:
Ideally hold CIM professional qualification or equivalent, or have studied some sort of marketing, and/ or 4-5yrs experience working in a marketing role.
Strong networking and presentation skills.
Excellent experience running digital marketing campaigns.
Previous experience with Adobe software is advantageous.
An ability to express views and ideas articulately, from both a written and oral perspective.
Confident and independent personal skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes.

Our client seeks a Client Bookkeeper to join their team on a 12 Month contract. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work within a sophisticated, director-led environment, supporting the financial administration of discerning private clients. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining comprehensive financial records, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and facilitating the production of high-quality financial reporting. Key Responsibilities: Ensuring all entities have accounting ledgers set up on Viewpoint or relevant accounting systems .Maintaining consistency with central chart of accounts and obtaining approval for any changes. Processing purchase and sales invoices for client accounting purposes.Posting bank entries through manual entry or upload processes. Reconciling customer receipts, supplier payments and bank statements. Processing monthly journals and accruals as required.Reviewing ledger accounts to ensure readiness for year-end statement preparation.Preparing year-end journals and accounts files for Financial Statement preparation.Engaging with client administrators regarding accounting queries. Preparing VAT returns and ensuring timely submission. Preparing client bank reconciliations for review.Producing management accounts and aged debtor/creditor lists. Completing time billing system entries on a daily basis.Preparing minutes to approve tax returns and Financial Statements. Drafting simple financial statements where required. Key Skills and Experience: Relevant qualification (CAT/AAT) or demonstrable willingness to study. Minimum 3 years; relevant experience in CSP or related environment.Knowledge and experience of accounting software systems, particularly Viewpoint and Xero.Proven experience processing invoices, reconciling accounts and maintaining accounting ledger systems. Understanding of relevant legislation and regulation of financial accounts administration. Strong IT skills including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16510

This role involves leading the development and execution of effectively targeted global marketing campaigns while supporting the enhancement of brand identity. The Marketing Communications and Operations Manager will be responsible for maximising relationships with key third parties, including vendors and agencies, to ensure collaborative success. The position requires developing marketing infrastructure and processes to drive best practices and efficiencies. The Manager will work closely with the broader Business Development and Marketing (BD&M) team and internal stakeholders to deliver worldwide support. This role is full-time, with the potential for flexible working arrangements. The successful candidate will take charge of creating multi-regional marketing campaigns based on market trends and client intelligence. Create complex transactions on ACBS based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements.

Notes
Our client seeks a Client Accountant to assist their team on a 12 month contract. Profile: To provide accounting and financial reporting services to a portfolio of clients. Preparation of periodic financial reporting in accordance with relevant accounting and industry standards and providing, assistance and advice on accounting related matters generally. Liaison with stakeholders, external accountant and auditors as necessary. Key Responsibilities:Manage the recording of financial information and preparation of financial statements for an allocated portfolio of entities with completion in a timely manner and in accordance with the relevant jurisdictional client accounting policy and procedures. Maintain accurate day to day client ledgers, ensuring all transactions are in-line with source documentation, of complex transactions, flow of funds, multi-currency for all cash and non-cash transaction. Keeping up to date accounting records for client entities, paying particular attention to bank statements, agreements, invoices, contracts and other documents signed by an entity. Liaising with the Administration Team on accounts queries. Preparing annual financial statements, solvency tests, asset statements and other ad-hoc financial reporting with accuracy and completeness together with additional reporting to meet deadlines for tax returns and jurisdictional annual filings. Preparation of tax returns for UK property holding with HMRC, IOM tax returns and any other relevant tax return. Providing first contact technical assistance to the accounting team as required Maintaining an awareness of changes to the relevant financial, legal and regulatory framework within which the company operates. Meet internal deadlines whilst maintaining a high attention to detail, accuracy and consistency across all clients financial records within the relevant jurisdictional accounting software, and MS Excel for checklists and additional schedules. Update accounts monitoring system. Key Skills & Experience:A relevant qualification (e.g., ACCA) or a minimum of 3 years experience in a similar role. Preferably Fiduciary experience of accounting for company and trust structures. Effective communication skills - both verbal and written. Has an enquiring mind, being able to question, research, apply and share...

For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16509

Our client seeks a Tax Advisor to join their team. This role will support the business by providing expert indirect tax advice and ensuring compliance with applicable tax legislations across all business activities. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, clients and external advisors to identify efficient solutions, minimise risk, and support the achievement of business objectives. Key Responsibilities: Support the delivery of VAT advisory projects across a broad portfolio of clients and sectors. Prepare technical VAT advice, reports and client deliverables, applying Isle of Man/UK VAT legislation and case law. Assist with complex advisory assignments. Build strong client relationships, acting as a day-to-day contact for allocated workstreams. Analyse client data and provide practical, commercially focused VAT solutions. Collaborate with colleagues on multidisciplinary projects. Continue developing your technical knowledge while supporting the growth of the wider practice. Using judgement to highlight and report significant matters that require the attention of management. Key Skills and Experience: Experience in VAT gained within practice or industry concerning the aviation and yachting sectors. A good understanding of IoM/UK VAT legislation and an interest in developing your advisory expertise. Confident in the use of Microsoft Word and Excel. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with clients and colleagues. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. A collaborative approach and a genuine desire to continue learning and developing. Able to take accountability and responsibility for own personal development. Able to work independently within agreed objectives, taking personal responsibility for delivery. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16720

Our client seeks a Head of Management Accounting to join their team. Role Profile: To ensure the monthly management accounts for the Group are produced on a timely basis and are complete and accurate. Key Responsibilities: Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Group Finance department (Isle of Man and UK). Manage and review the management accounts process for all subsidiaries of the group, ensuring production and distribution within 10 working days. Preparation of monthly Group Management accounts and distributing to the Boards within 10 working days, assisting with any questions and queries. Co-ordinate and review the credit risk report and provide commentary. Attend and contribute in Credit Committee meetings, adequately answering all questions from members. Monthly review of payroll (Isle of Man and UK), control account reconciliation and defined benefit payment and reconciliation. Co-ordinating and reviewing efficiencies and assisting with projects when required. Liaison for internal and external audit in respect of Management Accounting enquiries. Liaison for internal departments for finance related matters in respect to daily operations. Ensuring timely completion and submission of Corporate Tax returns (Isle of Man and UK). Reviewing work completed by other team members, raising any issues arising at an early stage. Ensure timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Supervisor of Sun/Vision Systems for the Management Accounting group. Assist with the training of staff members, working with them to expand their knowledge and experience. Key Skills & Experience A minimum of 5 years' experience in the finance sector. ACCA or ACA qualified. Supervisor/ System Administrator SUN/VISION account systems. Report writing. Systematic work approach and excellent attention to detail. ICEB Administrator or similar experience.

A unique chance to join a thriving private dental practice in one of the most sought-after locations in the British Isles. This is a fantastic opportunity for a full-time associate to join our friendly, well established 3 surgery private practice to replace departing long-standing dentist. 
We are looking for an enthusiastic colleague, with experience in all areas of general practice and who may also be a specialist in training, or have other special interests, to complement our existing team. There is an established Fee-Per-Item and plan list of generally stable and well-maintained patients.
Established and experienced support team (including dental therapist) ready to welcome a new colleague to our fabulous practice. The position is available from September 2026.

If you are passionate about dentistry and eager to contribute to a thriving practice, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as an Associate Dentist.

Notes
About Us:

Woodbourne Dental is a modern and well-established dental practice in Douglas, Isle of Man, committed to providing top-quality dental care in a friendly and professional environment. We are seeking a dedicated and organized Dental Nurse to join our team.

Job Purpose

To provide chairside support to dental professionals while delivering excellent patient care and progressing towards a recognized dental nursing qualification.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the dentist during a variety of treatments, including routine check-ups, fillings, and surgical procedures.
Set up and clean down surgeries before and after each patient in accordance with infection prevention and control protocols.
Ensure all equipment is sterilized and safe for use, following infection control procedures.
Prepare and maintain the clinical environment, including instruments and materials.
Perform intraoral scanning under supervision, aiding with digital impressions and workflow for orthodontic, restorative, or cosmetic treatments.
Deliver excellent patient care and support, ensuring a comfortable and welcoming experience.
Accurately record patient details, procedures, and notes as directed by the dentist, including maintaining logbooks.
Ensure that patient confidentiality is always maintained.
Adhere to all CQC, GDPR, and health and safety guidelines.
Attend off-site or online training as part of the dental nurse qualification.
Participate in the wider team effort, including reception duties or assisting other nurses and clinicians as needed.
Stay updated with current dental best practices and maintain CPD in line with GDC requirements (qualified nurses) or training program guidelines (trainees).
Essential Requirements:

A genuine interest in dental healthcare and patient welfare.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to enrol in and complete an accredited dental nursing qualification.
Professional appearance and attitude.
Ability to follow instructions and work under pressure.
Must be a resident on IOM or have a valid working permit
Desirable but not essential:

Previous experience in a healthcare or customer service role.
Knowledge of basic dental terminology.
Familiarity with dental software (e.g. SOE, R4) is a plus.

You will assess, diagnose, treatment plan and provide appropriate dental treatment, while maintaining accurate clinical records and ensuring patients receive appropriate information regarding their treatment and oral health.
The ideal candidate for the role of Dentist / Associate Dentist will be (Essential) - Qualified dentist with the appropriate professional registration/eligibility to practise in the Isle of Man, GDC registration or ability to obtain and maintain the required registration, NHS Performer Number or eligibility to obtain one, where required for the role, ability to provide safe and effective general dental care.

Notes
A wonderful opportunity has become available for a Qualified or experienced Trainee Dental Nurse to join our team at Grove Mount Dental Practice, Grove Mount South, IM8 3EY. 
We are a well established practice located in Ramsey, Isle of Man, close to the marina. The island offers a relaxed way of life with a very friendly community, we call our practice a “family dental health centre” as we want patients of all ages to enjoy lasting dental health.

Job Title: Qualified/Trainee Dental Nurse.
Salary: TBC dependent on experience.
Hours: Full Time or Part Time (Flexible working hours available).

Practice opening hours:
Monday – Thursday 8.30-5.30.
Friday 8.30-4.30.

Key responsibilities & duties:
Providing the highest standard of clinical support to our dentists and hygiene therapists.
Perform top quality dental nursing in all procedures in a safe and effective manner.
Prepare equipment, materials, lab work and patients with efficiency and empathy.
Checking stock + preparing orders.
Carrying out audits.
Preparing referrals.
Deliver outstanding customer service experiences.
Ad hoc reception duties.

Academic or trade qualifications:
GDC registered.
Trainees with minimum 6 months will be considered.
Excellent organisation, verbal and written communication skills.
Knowledge of Pearl + Excel desirable but not essential.

Work experience and skills:
Having an ambitious, positive and enthusiastic attitude with a great patient focus.
Variety of roles available for nursing staff and extended duties are actively encouraged, lots of patient interaction and opportunity to work in a busy active team.
Ability to work as part of a team.
Proactive approach.
Computer savvy and able to multitask.
Maintaining patient confidentiality.

What we offer in practice:
We are private dental practice in Ramsey, Isle of Man only a short walk from shops.
We provide services which include General and Cosmetic Dentistry, Invisalign, Whitening, Dentures and Hygiene therapists with 5 surgeries in total.
GDC, Indemnity and CPD costs covered.
Support of Practice Manager and Area Manager.
Opportunities for growth and development as we are a growing practice and an expanding dental group.
Additional leave to celebrate your birthday!
Annual cost of living wage increase.
Mintago membership.

If you are interested in this role, please send your CV to Sharon.newton@gensmile.co.uk

Our group employs around 400 people across multiple locations, providing care and support to residents throughout the Isle of Man.  We are an established private care provider with a strong commitment to quality, our residents and the people who deliver their care.  Our nursing home has approximately 50-60 beds, creating the opportunity for an experienced manager to lead a substantial service while still knowing the residents, families and team personally.
The Role; As Registered Manager, you will take overall responsibility for the leadership and day-to-day management of the home.  You will be responsible for creating a culture in which residents receive excellent, person-centred care and colleagues feel supported, valued and able to do their very best work.
You will provide visible, compassionate and effective leadership.  Lead, motivate and develop a multidisciplinary team.  Ensure consistently high standards of resident care and experience.  Maintain strong clinical, regulatory and safeguarding standards.  Work closely with residents, relatives and healthcare professionals.   Lead continuous improvement and quality initiatives. Manage staffing, resources, budgets and operational performance. Develop a positive culture of accountability, teamwork and professional development. Build strong relationships with families, colleagues and the wider community.
We are looking for someone who is confident to lead, compassionate enough to listen and ambitious enough to make a real difference.
You will ideally be an experienced Registered Manager, or Deputy Manager or Senior Care professional with a strong track record in nursing care.

Notes
Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

What are you waiting for? We’d be delighted to hear from you with your application.

You will lead and motivate the team to develop the overall quality of the service including individualised approaches, outcome focused support planning, contract management, finance, health and safety and staffing. The successful candidate will provide regular supervisions, guidance and direction to the team. To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to deliver a highly personalised service to adults with a diagnosis of ASC and actively encourage community access for service user’s and enable active participation in a variety of activities to increase their independence and live successful as a valued member of the community.

Ideally you will hold a Level 5 Health and Social Care qualification, or you will be required to obtain this qualification on successful appointment.

To support you in your new role we offer a full induction and ongoing Learning and Development opportunities including autism specific approaches.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

Notes
At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make your store the very best. 

Who you are?   We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and team player, who can strike up a good conversation.  You will already have a proven track record in a customer facing hospitality role with ideally a minimum of 2 years previous experience.

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, there are opportunities for development and progression within your store or one of our other stores on the Island, daily working hours (no late evenings), free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday, and recognition awards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to fancyacoffee@outlook.com

Notes
We are seeking an energetic and passionate Head Chef to join our team, who is keen to
take an active role in both the executive management of the business, as well as being
hands-on in the kitchen. We are looking for an individual who can take a holistic view on the
business, and work with our General Manager and Owners to further refine and define the
next stages of the business strategy and implementation of the same to carry Kellas into the
future, building on the strong foundations already laid.

On a day-to-day basis, our Head Chef will be hands-on, leading our culinary team and
elevating the dining experience. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of food
preparation, kitchen operations, and team management to ensure the highest standards of
quality, safety, and hospitality. Your leadership will inspire creativity in the kitchen while
maintaining efficient workflows and exceptional service. This is an exciting opportunity for a
culinary professional eager to make a lasting impact through exceptional cuisine and
outstanding team collaboration.

Summary of Key Responsibilities
Work closely with the rest of the Executive Management Team to drive food sales
and enhance the guest experience.
Design and develop menus, seasonal dishes, and daily specials.
Recruit, train, motivate, and develop kitchen team members.
Prepare and deliver high-quality fresh food to consistently high standards. With a
strong ability in breads and sauces and creative knack for adapting British classics
and giving them a modern twist.
Lead and manage the day-to-day running of the kitchen.
Lead kitchen service and ensure smooth operation during busy periods.
Monitor gross profit margins and food costs to ensure profitability targets are met.
Manage food ordering, stock control, and supplier relationships.
Control stock levels, minimise waste, and maximise kitchen efficiency.
Maintain exceptional standards of food hygiene, cleanliness, and kitchen
organisation.
Ensure full compliance with food safety, health and safety, and allergen regulations.
Manage kitchen paperwork, due diligence records, and HACCP procedures.

To apply for the position, please submit your CV and cover letter via email to our General Manager, at neil@kellas.im

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:  
Enthusiastic, energetic and resourceful with excellent customer service. Hard worker, professionally committed and responsible. Maintain focus in demanding work environments, under deadline and pressure conditions. 
Making pizza dough, managing dough fermentation, production of dough balls. -Preparation of vegetables, meats, sausages, sauces. 
Inspect and clean food preparation areas, such as equipment and work surfaces, or serving areas to ensure safe and sanitary food handling practices. 
Ensure food is stored and cooked at correct temperature by regulating temperature of ovens, grills, and fryers. 
Ensure freshness of food and ingredients by checking for quality, keeping track of old and new items, rotating stock.  
Season and cook foods according to recipes or personal judgment and experience being sure to constantly turn or stir foods to ensure even cooking.  
Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients according to recipes or personal judgment.  
Take orders from customers and cook foods requiring short preparation time and according to customer’s requirements.  
Restock kitchen supplies, rotate food, and stamp the time and date on food in coolers. 
Applying correct toppings on the desired crust style, and then baking. 
Have to know the importance of teamwork. 
Cleanliness and food safety standards must always be the first concern through this process.  
Assembling pizzas exactly as the customer had ordered. 
Deep cleaning to the kitchen ones a week. 
Needs to have some knowledge about dough, flour, yeast, dough fermentation. 
Also needs to have some knowledge about toppings like cheese, some vegetables and some meats. Training can be given if is needed. 

Abilities required: 
 Must be able to work on evenings and late nights. 
Must be able to work long hours. 
Must be able to work on bank holidays and special days. 
Must be able to work in busy and hot kitchen. 
Must be able to work fast and accurate. 
Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service. 
Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion.
Physical Requirements:  
Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions. 
Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

£13.00

Notes
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:  
Enthusiastic, energetic and resourceful with excellent customer service. Hard worker, professionally committed and responsible. Maintain focus in demanding work environments, under deadline and pressure conditions. 
Making pizza dough, managing dough fermentation, production of dough balls. -Preparation of vegetables, meats, sausages, sauces. 
Inspect and clean food preparation areas, such as equipment and work surfaces, or serving areas to ensure safe and sanitary food handling practices. 
Ensure food is stored and cooked at correct temperature by regulating temperature of ovens, grills, and fryers. 
Ensure freshness of food and ingredients by checking for quality, keeping track of old and new items, rotating stock.  
Season and cook foods according to recipes or personal judgment and experience being sure to constantly turn or stir foods to ensure even cooking.  
Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients according to recipes or personal judgment.  
Take orders from customers and cook foods requiring short preparation time and according to customer’s requirements.  
Restock kitchen supplies, rotate food, and stamp the time and date on food in coolers. 
Applying correct toppings on the desired crust style, and then baking. 
Have to know the importance of teamwork. 
Cleanliness and food safety standards must always be the first concern through this process.  
Assembling pizzas exactly as the customer had ordered. 
Deep cleaning to the kitchen ones a week. 
Needs to have some knowledge about dough, flour, yeast, dough fermentation. 
Also needs to have some knowledge about toppings like cheese, some vegetables and some meats. Training can be given if is needed. 

Abilities required: 
Must be able to work on evenings and late nights. 
Must be able to work long hours. 
Must be able to work on bank holidays and special days. 
Must be able to work in busy and hot kitchen. 
Must be able to work fast and accurate. 
Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service. 
Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion
Physical Requirements:  
Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions. 
Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

For more details and to apply contact bfpizza.iom@gmail.com

The Boatyard is a busy, modern coastal restaurant on Peel harbour, known for fresh seafood, seasonal menus, and a warm, professional team culture. We’re looking for a talented Sous Chef to join our kitchen and help lead service with creativity, consistency, and pride.

The Role:
As Sous Chef, you’ll work closely with our Head Chef to deliver high?quality, seafood?focused dishes that celebrate local produce. You’ll take ownership of day?to?day kitchen operations, support junior chefs, and ensure every plate leaving the pass reflects our standards.

What We’re Looking For:
Strong experience in a professional kitchen, ideally with seafood, confidence running a section and leading service, a passion for fresh, local produce, good communication and leadership skills, high standards, attention to detail, and pride in your work, someone who thrives in a busy, supportive team environment.

Competitive pay based on experience, a supportive, friendly team and positive working culture, opportunities for progression and creative input, a beautiful coastal workplace with a strong local following.

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member
South of the Island

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH)
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends)
Pay: Minimum wage
Location: South of the island
Own transport: Essential
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
•	Opening and closing of the cafe
•	Greet, assist and seat guests
•	Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH)
•	Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food)
•	Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards
•	Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals
•	Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service
•	Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service
•	Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed
•	Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers
•	Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation
•	Filing of delivery notes and invoices
•	Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items
•	Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies
•	Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required
•	Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback
•	Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling
•	Always maintain a professional appearance
•	Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners
About You
•	Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred
•	Own reliable transport is essential
•	Warm, friendly and customer-focused
•	Reliable, punctual and well-presented
•	Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team
•	Good communication skills and a positive attitude
•	Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends
What We Offer
•	A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment
•	Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster
•	The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im.

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

We’re looking for chefs who takes pride in producing great food, enjoys working as part of a team and thrives in a busy kitchen environment. You’ll be working alongside our kitchen management team to help deliver the high-quality food that Smoky Sam’s is known for.

As a CDP or Sous Chef, you’ll be responsible for running your section to a high standard, preparing and cooking food consistently, maintaining excellent food hygiene and safety standards and helping to ensure every dish leaving the kitchen meets our expectations.

You’ll be expected to take responsibility for your section, including preparation, stock rotation, ordering and maintaining a clean and organised workstation. You’ll also help support junior members of the kitchen team, communicate effectively during service and work closely with the senior kitchen team to keep services running smoothly.

For the right person, this role can offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the business. We’re looking for someone who wants to develop their skills, is confident working under pressure and is willing to lead by example.

Previous professional kitchen experience is essential, with CDP or Sous Chef experience preferred. Experience working in a busy restaurant environment would be a strong advantage. BBQ experience isn’t essential, but a genuine passion for food and willingness to learn our style of cooking is a must.
We’re looking for someone who is reliable, organised and passionate about hospitality. You’ll need to be a strong team player with a positive attitude and the ability to stay calm and focused during busy services.

If you’re looking for your next challenge and want to be part of a growing BBQ restaurant with a strong team and plenty of opportunity to develop, we’d love to hear from you.

Please Email smokysamsbbq@gmail.com with a copy of your CV

MANX WORKERS ONLY
Locals or work permit holders

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member
South of the Island

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH)
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends)
Pay: Minimum wage
Location: South of the island
Own transport: Essential

What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe
Greet, assist and seat guests
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH)
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food)
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation
Filing of delivery notes and invoices
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling
Always maintain a professional appearance
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners

About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred
Own reliable transport is essential
Warm, friendly and customer-focused
Reliable, punctual and well-presented
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team
Good communication skills and a positive attitude
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.

How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im.

Smoky Sam’s BBQ is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Supervisor to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about great food, excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for both our customers and our team. As a Restaurant Supervisor, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the restaurant and helping to make sure every customer has a fantastic experience.

You’ll be responsible for supervising the team during shifts, ensuring the restaurant is running smoothly and maintaining our high standards of service, cleanliness and food quality. You’ll lead by example, support and motivate team members, and help create a friendly and welcoming environment.

The ideal person will have previous experience in a restaurant, hospitality or supervisory role, although we’re also happy to consider someone with the right attitude, personality and willingness to learn. You’ll need to be confident communicating with both customers and staff, able to stay calm and organised during busy periods, and comfortable taking responsibility when required.

You’ll help with opening and closing the restaurant, managing shifts, supporting the team during busy services, dealing with customer queries and resolving any issues professionally. You’ll also work closely with management to ensure company standards and procedures are followed.

We believe our team is just as important as the food we serve. We’re looking for someone who is reliable, approachable, hardworking and enjoys being part of a team. If you’re someone who takes pride in your work and wants to help us continue providing great food and great service, we’d love to hear from you.
 Please send a copy of your CV and a small bit about yourself and why you would be a great fit at Smoky Sam's to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Notes
Our client seeks a Software Engineer to join their team. Key Responsibilities: Build and own some of the projects end to end: backend, deployment, and the day-to-day of keeping them healthy. Design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read. Work with AI agents as a normal part of how you build, and know when to trust them and when not to. Integrate with third-party services (KYC providers, payment and gaming platforms, forensic data sources). Pick up whatever the project needs, including bits of frontend, data work, and infrastructure. Key Skills & Experience: Strong backend engineering in at least one language, and the sense to pick the right tool rather than the familiar one. Cloud and deployment. You can put a service into production and look after it, not just write the code. Solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You think about failure, data, and maintenance before you think about frameworks. Fluent with agentic development. You've built real things with coding agents (Claude Code or similar) and you understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration. You have a view on where they help and where they get in the way. API design and integration. Clean interfaces, sensible contracts, third-party services wired in without drama. Desirable: Enough frontend and UI sense to build a decent interface, even if you're not a frontend specialist. Comfortable across several languages, for example Python, Go, or Java, and happy to pick up whatever a project calls for. Application security, and care when handling sensitive data. Any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16686

The Head of Data is a pivotal role responsible for overseeing the core data capability within a dynamic financial services group. This includes owning the data architecture, models, integrations, analytics, and reporting estate across multiple jurisdictions. The position requires a strategic vision for data as a valuable asset, ensuring it is well-governed, reliable, and readily accessible to support business operations and regulatory compliance. This role entails close collaboration with various teams, including Infrastructure, Business Applications, Security, and Data Protection, to translate the data strategy into actionable delivery. Furthermore, the Head of Data will need to have a robust practical knowledge and hands-on skills alongside managerial abilities to guide a talented team of data engineers and analysts. The position reports directly to the Group CTO and acts as the primary contact for data-related inquiries within the business, accommodating the growth, acquisitions, and technology advancements of the organisation. Are you an experienced Environment Manager looking to take ownership of a complex, business critical technology landscape? Our client seeks an Environment Manager to assist their team. Role Profile: To lead the governance, planning and operational management of development, test and pre-production environments across both on premise and Azure cloud platforms. Reporting to the Head of IT Delivery, you will play a key role in enabling reliable, high-quality software delivery across multiple products, teams and suppliers. Key Responsibilities: Define, own and evolve the environment management strategy and roadmap. Manage the full lifecycle of development, test and pre-production environments. Ensure environments are stable, available and ready to support delivery, testing and release activities. Coordinate environment demand, scheduling and capacity across multiple teams and suppliers. Drive standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across the environment estate. Work closely with DevOps, Testing, Architecture, Infrastructure and third-party partners to improve delivery outcomes. Key Skills and Experience: Proven experience managing complex IT environments across multiple platforms and suppliers. Strong understanding of environment lifecycle management, SDLC and software delivery practices. Experience supporting Agile and Waterfall delivery teams. Excellent stakeholder management, planning and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure environments, including Azure cloud technologies. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16675

Our client seeks a Data Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To manage the Group data lakes, management information and business intelligence systems, designing databases, enforcing quality standards, and ensuring compliance with privacy and security regulations. To bridge the gap between technical IT teams and business managers by transforming raw data into actionable intelligence, ensuring the organisation's data is accurate, secure and effectively managed to support business decision making. Key Skills &  Experience: Usually degree educated in IT, Computer Science or statistical methods, with relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in programming languages and database systems like SQL, Python, Oracle. Solid understanding of data modelling / warehousing concepts and modern enterprise data architecture principles. Knowledge of ETL development and Data Pipeline orchestration using Apache Kafka & SSISSSAS Tabular Model development, DAX calculations/optimization, and Kimball-style dimensional data modelling (Star/Snowflake schemas). Data Visualization: Experience utilizing platforms such Power BI & SSRS, or similar BI software such as Tableau. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate integrity and interpret inconsistencies across large, complex datasets. Manage and develop a small, high performing data team, including mentoring, 1:1s and continuous improvement initiatives. Proven experience in a similar role. Experience analysing complex data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support business decision-making. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions. High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16688
