Are you an experienced Software Engineer looking to help deliver high-quality digital and data solutions within a modern technology environment?

IFGL is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and play a key role in the development, support and continuous improvement of our digital services, data platforms and business-critical applications. Reporting to the Engineering Team Lead, you will work closely with Architecture, Product and Delivery teams to design, build and maintain secure, scalable and reliable technology solutions that support our business objectives and technology strategy. This hands-on role offers the opportunity to work with cloud technologies, modern engineering practices and data-driven solutions whilst contributing to the ongoing evolution of our technology estate.

The main duties for this role are:
Deliver secure, scalable and reliable digital solutions, including data-centric applications, services and APIs, that meet business requirements and provide sustainable business value.
Design, optimise and support databases, data models and data services to ensure data quality, accessibility, performance and operational resilience.
Implement cloud-based and hybrid technology solutions that align with architectural standards, security requirements and long-term platform objectives.
Translate architectural designs and business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring consistency with engineering standards and best practice.
Improve engineering quality and delivery efficiency through automation, testing, CI/CD pipelines and the continuous enhancement of development practices.
Maintain service availability and operational stability through effective support, incident resolution and problem management activities.
Keep technical knowledge current by monitoring emerging technologies and engineering practices, identifying opportunities to improve organisational capability and delivery outcomes.

Please visit https://www.ifg-ltd.com/careers/ for the full job advert.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

Experience in handling external telephone calls and emails with both clients and independent financial advisor. Highly self-motivated individual who is willing to participate and actively assist in improving current processes. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Be passionate about delivering excellent customer service. Competent in Microsoft applications: Including Word, Outlook, SharePoint and Excel. Knowledge of Finscan would be desirable. Notes
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Project Manager to oversee the successful delivery of projects from mobilisation through to completion. You will be responsible for coordinating project activities, managing programmes, monitoring costs and procurement, and ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time and to the required quality standards.

The role will involve preparing cost estimates, managing subcontractors and suppliers, attending site visits and inspections, monitoring progress and identifying and resolving risks and issues. You will provide regular updates to senior management on project costs, programme, risks and opportunities, while maintaining accurate project records and ensuring compliance with health & safety, quality and regulatory requirements.

You will work closely with clients, contractors, suppliers and internal teams, building strong professional relationships and ensuring projects are delivered effectively and to the highest standard.

About You

You will ideally have experience in project management within facilities management, construction, office refurbishments or M&E building services, together with an understanding of cost control, procurement and contract administration.

Strong organisational and communication skills are essential, along with excellent attention to detail and confidence using Excel and producing clear reports. You will be proactive, commercially aware and able to manage multiple live projects, make decisions, resolve issues and escalate where appropriate.

An interest or experience in Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) services and maintenance is advantageous. Familiarity with Isle of Man construction standards and/or a relevant qualification or professional pathway such as Construction Management, RICS or CIOB would also be beneficial.

For more information about Prospero, including our employee benefits and what we can offer you, please visit www.prospero.im.
Interested?  Please send your CV to hr@prospero.im

Are you an experienced customer service professional with management skills, judgement and commitment to making a meaningful difference to people’s homes and communities?

We are looking for an ambitious, approachable and highly organised Assistant Housing Manager (services) to join our Housing & Property team.  This is an excellent opportunity to take a senior operational role in shaping and delivering responsive, high-quality housing services for tenants across the Council’s housing stock.

You will manage a dedicated customer services and sheltered housing function, helping residents access safe, well-managed homes and the support they need to live independently.  From overseeing allocations, tenancies, income collection and estate services to developing staff, improving performance and representing the Council with partner agencies, no two days will be the same.

You must be educated to A-level standard or equivalent and have substantial management experience, including experience of managing a team and delivering a customer-facing service.  You will need excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.  You should also have the ability to build productive relationships and be able to influence a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

If you are a confident people manager with strong customer-service values, with the ability to manage complex and sensitive matters, with a genuine commitment to public service, we would welcome an application from you. 

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Council’s website.  For an informal chat about the role please contact Jay Chatwood, Housing & Property Operation’s Manager, jchatwood@douglas.gov.im.  Alternatively, you can contact HR on (696455). 

The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is Sunday, 13th September 2026.

Notes
A Landscape Supervisor is needed to support the continual development of its landscapes, growth of the Living Collection and creation of a large, professional team. Reporting to a Landscape Manager, the Landscape Supervisor will be hands on, applying their knowledge and experience to a wide range of work including plant introduction and establishment, garden maintenance and mentoring. They will also be required to maintain digital records, help with procurement and be involved with team decisions.
Key Responsibilities include assisting with coordinating work programmes and initiatives to achieve specific objectives, collaborating effectively with colleagues and visitors, ensuring adherence with the SBG SOPs. They will also contribute to decision-making, work planning and scheduling, provide empathetic, professional guidance to team members, operate construction and horticultural machinery and equipment, participate in relevant training, undertake work-related travel, contribute to staff performance reviews and appraisals, assist with updating health and safety practices and ensure adherence to company Health and Safety Policy, participate in education, training and mentoring programs for SBG staff and visitors and drive a vehicle on public highways and estate land.

Qualifications and Experience includes a relevant academic qualification, ideally to level 5 (HND), 3-5 years of experience in a notable landscape, garden or commercial business, such experience to include personnel management, understand large landscape maintenance, possess competent knowledge of temperate plants and their requirements, have a good understanding of soils and management techniques, show dynamic methods of mentoring to encourage progress and professionalism and demonstrate drive, determination and adaptability to achieve success. The successful candidate will need a full UK driving licence as the role involves working at different sites.

For more details and to apply contact andrewjinglis@outlook.com

This role ensures that every office provides a professional, safe, and welcoming environment for employees and clients alike, while managing cost effectively and planning ahead for growth.
The ideal candidate for the role of Group Facilities Manager will have significant experience in facilities management, workplace strategy, or corporate real estate, ideally within a multi-site, multi-jurisdictional environment, a proven track record of leading office relocation, fit-out, or consolidation projects from inception to completion, strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget ownership, lease negotiation, and vendor management, and excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities across geographies.

We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout.

You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role.

They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential.

Notes
Are you a skilled Vehicle Technician looking to take the next step in your career? We are Nissan's authorised service & repair workshop on the Isle of Man, and we are looking for a talented, motivated, and customer-focused individual to join our dynamic workshop team in Ballasalla.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work with one of the world's leading automotive brands, utilising the latest diagnostic equipment and manufacturer training. Whether you are working on routine servicing or complex diagnostics and repairs, you will play a vital role in keeping our customers safely on the road.

In this role, you will be responsible for carrying out servicing, maintenance, and repairs on Nissan vehicles to the highest manufacturer standards. A core part of the position involves performing diagnostic work using Nissan's specialist CONSULT diagnostic equipment, completing warranty repairs, and supporting technical service campaigns. You will conduct thorough vehicle health checks and communicate your findings clearly to our service advisors, while proactively identifying any faults or emerging issues during inspection. You will also be expected to maintain a clean, safe, and well-organised workshop environment at all times, complete job cards and workshop documentation accurately, and keep your technical knowledge current through Nissan's ongoing manufacturer training programmes and technical bulletins.

We are seeking a candidate who holds a recognised automotive qualification such as NVQ Level 2 or 3, City & Guilds, or an equivalent accreditation, along with proven hands-on experience as a Vehicle Technician in either a franchised or independent workshop setting. You should have solid experience working with modern vehicle diagnostic systems, and whilst Nissan or other manufacturer-brand training is desirable, it is by no means essential as full training will be provided. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes pride in the quality of their work, communicates well with colleagues and customers alike, holds a full valid Isle of Man driving licence, and has the drive and initiative to perform equally well working independently or as part of a close-knit team.

To apply for this position, please send your CV and a covering letter to: gm@athol.co.im

This is a combined role at Quinns, a growing Isle of Man property law firm. As Sales and Marketing Manager, the successful candidate will take day-to-day ownership of the firm's growth engine: responding to and converting all inbound client enquiries, planning and executing marketing campaigns, managing the firm's social media channels and CRM system, and creating the firm's multimedia content, including planning, filming, editing and producing professional video content and producing and editing podcast episodes. Alongside these responsibilities, the role includes a structured trainee conveyancer pathway through the Quinns Academy, with the successful candidate undertaking formal training in residential conveyancing and progressing, under supervision, towards managing their own caseload of property transactions. Applicants must have proven experience in a sales and marketing role, including demonstrable hands-on experience of creating, filming and editing video content and of producing podcasts, which is essential to this position, together with strong written and verbal communication skills, confidence with CRM and social media management tools, and a genuine commitment to training and qualifying in conveyancing, including a willingness to undertake sustained study alongside work. Above all, the successful candidate must share the values at the heart of everything we do at Quinns. To apply, please send your CV and a covering letter explaining your experience and why you want this role to careers@quinns.law.

Notes
Our client seeks a FATCA/CRS Analyst to join their team on a Temporary 6-Month Contract. Our client is a highly respected financial services group with an impressive international reach, operating across investment management, digital banking and open-architecture investment platform services. With a strong track record of serving financial intermediaries, corporate clients, trustees and high-net-worth individuals across the globe, this is an organisation built on trusted relationships, technical excellence and a genuine commitment to client-first values. You will be responsible for undertaking retrospective reviews of client records to ensure compliance with the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) and Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) regulations. The role focuses on validating the accuracy, completeness, and reasonableness of client self-certifications in accordance with CRS due diligence requirements, including enhanced requirements introduced under CRS 2.0.  The successful candidate will conduct detailed reviews of customer documentation, identify remediation requirements, engage with internal stakeholders, and support regulatory reporting obligations by ensuring tax residency information maintained by the Bank is accurate and current. Key Skills and Experience: Experience working within Banking or Financial Services. Working knowledge of FATCA and CRS regulations. Experience reviewing client due diligence and KYC documentation. Understanding of tax residency concepts and regulatory reporting requirements. Experience conducting customer remediation or retrospective review activities.
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16768

Notes
Our Isle of Man office is looking for an individual with strong interpersonal skills who enjoys variety in their working day, to join us as Receptionist & Facilities Support on a full-time, permanent basis to assist the current team. 

This is a dual role, working predominantly on our Reception Desk but providing facilities support as and when required in a flexible capacity. 

Due to local immigration restrictions, we are only able to consider candidates who are local Manx residents

As Receptionist, you will be required to:

Operate the office switchboard 
Provide reception ‘meeting and greeting’ services to clients and office visitors
Organise client meeting room booking requests and prepare rooms for meetings
Provide routine office administration to assist the wider business
Book taxis and local accommodation for staff
Liaise with external office services e.g. couriers and receive small deliveries from suppliers or clients
Manage the office equipment loan stock for staff, for example portable printers and scanners
Logging and following up on Helpdesk tickets

Our Receptionist is the main contact point for our business and will be dealing with clients and suppliers and liaising with our staff. You will be dealing with a wide variety of activities, ranging from managing the reception desk and switchboard to organising meeting rooms, co-ordinating taxi bookings and assisting with administrative tasks.

In providing Facilities support, you will be required to assist with:

Replenishing and maintaining the kitchen areas on each floor, and vending machine in Staff Room
Collecting and distributing fruit and milk deliveries
Monitoring shredding bins on each floor and arranging collection
Maintaining photocopier and stationary areas on each floor – distributing supplies and consumables
Maintaining oversight and ensuring appropriate stock levels for vending machines and water towers
Liaising with third-party suppliers relating to PPM, Air Conditioning, ad-hoc R&M requirements and cleaning contracts
Ordering Supplies for the kitchens, vending machines, printers and stationary

Candidates do not need to have prior office experience to succeed in this role, however they should have strong communication skills and a proactive approach to working. 

Working hours are 08:45am - 5pm Monday to Friday 

To thrive in this role, you will also need:

Logical approach to task management 
Strong interpersonal skills 
Self-motivation and ability to use own initiative 
Readiness to work flexibly outside of core business hours (9am - 5:15pm) to support office based events, as required 
Intermediate knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite of programmes, with emphasis on Outlook
Language requirements - strong spoken, listening and written English
Previous experience in office facilities would be advantageous although not essential
Previous experience working on a Reception Desk within the financial services industry is preferable but not mandatory

To apply for this role please email Khamon@kpmg.com or call 01534608403

This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional with investment management experience to take responsibility for a key regulatory function within an established business. The successful candidate will be responsible for the Isle of Man compliance function, ensuring the business continues to meet its regulatory obligations. The firm is regulated by the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) as an Investment Manager and also operates within a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulated environment. The role will focus primarily on Isle of Man regulatory requirements, with external specialist support already in place for US SEC compliance matters. Previous SEC experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Key Responsibilities: Act as Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Isle of Man regulated activities. Maintain and oversee the compliance framework in line with IOMFSA requirements. Provide compliance advice and guidance to the business. Review, update and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls. Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant changes. Oversee AML/CFT obligations and ensure appropriate controls remain in place. Support regulatory reporting and compliance monitoring activities. Work alongside external advisers supporting US SEC compliance requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience within investment management compliance. Experience working within a regulated financial services environment. Experience acting as a Compliance Officer and/or MLRO. Strong understanding of AML/CFT requirements and regulatory frameworks. The ability to work independently and manage a broad compliance remit. Strong communication skills with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Experience within asset management, hedge funds or investment firms would be highly desirable.

Our client seeks a Regulatory Compliance Officer to join their team. Role Profile: To enable the execution of Compliance Risk Management processes and activities within a specific business/functional area, to ensure that the area is undertaken in a compliant manner to avoid operational losses, fines, penalties or reputational damage to the organisation and enable the competitive advantage of the organisation. Key Responsibilities: Analyse the operational activities within a functional area to identify compliance risks and therefore ensure adherence to the relevant compliance frameworks and standards. Customise and maintain generic risk management plans (RMPs) to ensure it is appropriate within the regulatory context of a specific functional area. Proactively identify and address gaps in controls, processes and procedures as well as advise on and monitor remediation plans to address any short-comings. Review compliance training material to ensure that it is appropriate for the needs of the functional area therefore providing sufficient understanding and awareness compliance requirements within the relevant area of operations and deliver bespoke face-to-face training where required. Review compliance frameworks, standards and procedures in the context of a functional area and advise on their customisation or amendment, where necessary. The role requires an expert in Compliance with a sound knowledge of the relevant regulatory requirements and upcoming developments applicable to a specific business area as well as a solid understanding of banking products and activities. Key Skills and Qualifications: First degree in Audit, Business Commerce or Lega. l5 - 7 years in Compliance. Evaluation of Internal Controls. Financial Acumen. Legal Compliance. Process Governance. Risk Awareness.

Notes
Self-Employed Sales Agent – Automotive Lubricants - Part time

We are looking for a friendly, professional and motivated self-employed sales agent to promote and sell Forté lubricants—an established, market-leading range of vehicle additives and workshop consumables—to customers throughout the automotive aftermarket, including workshops, dealerships and retail outlets across the Isle of Man.

This flexible, part-time opportunity would be ideal for someone who already represents a complementary, non-competing brand or works in a similar sales role. You will manage your own time and diary, making it easy to fit the role around your existing commitments. For the right person, there is potential to develop this into a full-time opportunity.

You will be part of a friendly, relaxed and supportive working environment while retaining the independence to develop your own customer relationships and sales territory.

What we offer:
A generous 20% commission rate. 
Uncapped earning potential. 
Realistically achievable bonus structure. 
Flexible, part-time hours. 
Freedom to manage your own diary and workload. 
The opportunity to develop the role into a full-time business. 
A friendly, relaxed and supportive working relationship. 
An established range of quality products. 

About you:
Friendly, confident and comfortable speaking with customers. 
Self-motivated, reliable and well organised. 
Smart and professional in appearance. 
Contactable during normal office hours. 
Able to work independently and manage your own appointments. 
Previous sales experience would be beneficial, particularly within the automotive, workshop, motor trade or a related sector. 
An existing network of relevant customers or a complementary agency would be an advantage. 

Essential requirements:
A full, valid driving licence. 
Your own suitable transport. 
Secure and appropriate storage space for holding stock. 
The ability to operate on a self-employed basis. 

This is a self-employed, commission-based opportunity and does not include a guaranteed salary. Your earnings will be based on your sales, with no upper limit on what you can earn.

If you are enthusiastic, professional and interested in developing a flexible sales opportunity around your existing commitments, we would be pleased to hear from you.
To apply for this role please call 	07858634837

Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, applying sound professional judgement to resolve problems and communicate clear, decisive solutions, escalating where appropriate. Strong communication and organisational skills. An enthusiastic, proactive and adaptable approach to work. Proactively keep up-to-date with industry legislation and proposed changes. Bring to the attention of Directors any issues of concern to ensure they are reported in a timely manner. Self-driven, results-oriented and reliable, with a positive outlook, and a clear focus on high quality service. Mature, credible and comfortable in dealing with professional people and high net worth individuals. Well-developed inter-personal skills, with an ability to motivate other administrators and interact with senior management. Self-Motivation and disciplined in task completion with the ability to resolve issues with minimum supervision. High level or organisational and prioritisation skills; flexibility and willingness to help other in a friendly and professional manner.

Are you a commercially minded lawyer looking for an opportunity to make a real impact within a fast-paced global technology business? Our client looks for a Senior Commercial Counsel to join their Legal team Role Profile: In this role, you'll work as part of the in-house Legal team, supporting the business on a wide range of commercial and legal matters with a particular focus on technology, software licensing, online gaming and digital products. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organisation, providing pragmatic legal advice, managing commercial negotiations, and helping the business navigate legal risk whilst supporting growth and innovation. This is a fantastic opportunity for a proactive lawyer who enjoys combining strong technical legal expertise with a commercial and solutions-focused mindset. Key Skills and Experience: Qualified Solicitor or Advocate. Excellent drafting, negotiation and contract review skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately under pressure. Ability to prioritise competing workloads and manage tight deadlines. Self-motivated, proactive and capable of taking ownership of matters from instruction through to completion. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. A collaborative approach and willingness to work as part of a team. Desirable - Experience within the online gaming, sports betting, technology or digital sectors. Experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts. Knowledge of software licensing, digital rights, e-commerce or related technology-focused legal matters. Experience supporting international businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities: Defining and executing test plans that ensure comprehensive coverage and quality, adhering to departments strategy and processes and implementing test standards and best practices across teams. Collaborating with Development, Change and business teams to align testing with delivery objectives. Proactively helping with testing to ensure team deadlines are achieved. Key Skills & Experience: ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing is essential, ISTQB Advanced level is desirable. Minimum 5 years experience of testing, with at least 3 years in a senior/lead role. Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular, is an advantage. Experience of test automation is an advantage. Excellent planning and organisational skills, able to manage multiple workloads concurrently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, ability to engage positively with & gain support from senior management/stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively, or on your own initiative, and deliver to tight deadlines. Strong understanding of Gherkin syntax, peer reviews and formal reviews. A genuine interest in technology and software testing.

PLUMBER – HOUSING MAINTENANCE TEAM
Douglas City Council are seeking a skilled, reliable and customer focused Plumber to join our Housing & Property Department to work within a supportive team committed to delivering responsive, professional and high-quality maintenance services to our community  

Carrying out a wide range of responsive and programmed plumbing repairs and maintenance works across Council owned domestic and commercial properties you must be competent in a broad range of internal and external plumbing works with an ability to undertake minor associated construction work necessary to complete repairs.  You must also have knowledge and experience of health and safety documentation, including risk assessments and method statements and an understanding of safe manual-handling techniques with the ability to carry out manual-handling operations.

You will be an experienced plumber with a strong practical background in construction, building maintenance or domestic repairs.  You will be able to work independently and as part of a team.  You must be able organise your workload effectively, meet deadlines, work with minimal supervision and provide a professional service at all times.   

Applicants must have a City & Guilds or NVQ Level 3 qualification in a relevant trade, relevant post-qualification experience, be registered with the Department of Enterprise Register of Craftsmen and Craftswomen as well as a full, clean and valid driving licence.  Strong communication skills, including the ability to deal fairly, respectfully and confidently with tenants and customer situations is also essential.  

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Council’s website.  For an informal chat about the role please contact Liam Birchall, Assistant Housing Manager (Maintenance) lbirchall@douglas.gov.im.  Alternatively, you can contact HR on (696455). 

The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is Sunday, 13th September 2026.

Bidvest Noonan is seeking reliable and professional Casual Security Officers to join our team at the Isle of Man Courts of Justice. This is a zero-hour contract position, providing cover on an as-required basis, making it ideal for individuals seeking flexible work opportunities.
About the Role
Working within a secure and professional environment, you will play a vital role in maintaining the safety and security of the Courts of Justice building, its staff, visitors, and users.
Using an airport-style security screening approach, your duties will include:
Monitoring access points to the Courts of Justice building.
Conducting security searches of persons and property before authorising entry.
Carrying out regular internal and external foot patrols.
Monitoring visitor numbers and maintaining accurate records and reports.
Operating and monitoring the building's CCTV systems.
Identifying and responding appropriately to disruptive or escalating behaviour.
Providing excellent customer service whilst maintaining a safe and secure environment.
Developing positive working relationships with court staff, service users, and our client.
What We're Looking For
The successful candidate will be:
Professional, reliable, and trustworthy.
Calm and patient under pressure.
An excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
Confident dealing with members of the public.
Flexible and available to work shifts at short notice when required.
Able to work independently and as part of a wider team.
Previous security experience is desirable but not essential, as full training will be provided.
Training
Successful candidates will receive comprehensive training, including:
Emergency First Aid at Work.
Automated External Defibrillation (AED).
Conflict Management and De-escalation.
Fire Marshal Training.
Control and Restraint.
Working Pattern
Casual 0-hour contract.
Monday to Friday shifts available as required.
Weekend on-call opportunities available.
Hours offered according to operational needs and cover requirements.
How to Apply
To apply, please submit your CV and a brief covering letter.

Using an airport-style security screening approach, your duties will include:
Monitoring access points to the Courts of Justice building.
Conducting security searches of persons and property before authorising entry.
Carrying out regular internal and external foot patrols.
Monitoring visitor numbers and maintaining accurate records and reports.
Operating and monitoring the building's CCTV systems.
Identifying and responding appropriately to disruptive or escalating behaviour.
Providing excellent customer service whilst maintaining a safe and secure environment.
Developing positive working relationships with court staff, service users, and our client.
What We're Looking For
The successful candidate will be:
Professional, reliable, and trustworthy.
Calm and patient under pressure.
An excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
Confident dealing with members of the public.
Flexible and available to work shifts at short notice when required.
Able to work independently and as part of a wider team.
Previous security experience is desirable but not essential, as full training will be provided.
Training
Successful candidates will receive comprehensive training, including:
Emergency First Aid at Work.
Automated External Defibrillation (AED).
Conflict Management and De-escalation.
Fire Marshal Training.
Control and Restraint.
Working Pattern
Casual 0-hour contract.
Monday to Friday shifts available as required.
Weekend on-call opportunities available.
Hours offered according to operational needs and cover requirements.

Notes
Van Mossel Jacksons are looking for an experienced Brand Manager in premium sales of motor vehicles (BYD & Volvo) to join their dedicated team. Working within Jacksons you will be skilled and seasoned Brand Manager in the sales of our current brands of premium new and preowned vehicles.

**Some of the responsibilities for the Brand Manager position are, but not limited to;**

Engage in the art of following up with both loyal and potential customers, nurturing relationships to bring about further transactions. 
Strive to meet and exceed monthly targets for the sale of both new and used cars. 
Seek out and approach new clients with steadfast determination, arranging meetings to understand and address their needs.
Achieve monthly sales targets for New and Used vehicles, achieving the minimum profit targets.
Achieve monthly sales targets for additional profit centres including finance.
Return correspondence from customers and ensure all matters of paperwork are tended to with diligence.
Seize every opportunity to maximise sales whilst ensuring complete customer satisfaction.

**The Brand Manager position comes with an excellent remuneration and other benefits;**

Starting Salary & excellent bonus scheme
Guaranteed Income: A generous sum guaranteed for the first three months as you train and settle in the new role.
Company Car: A desirable chariot. 
Training and Accreditation: To make sure you are developed to reach the highest level of commission.

**Requirements:**
You must possess experience in the sales, a requirement without compromise.
Knowledge of the Kerridge/ADP DMS system a benefit.
The gift of clear communication, both by phone and in person, is essential.
A valid Driving Licence.
Highly presentable, ambitious and target driven, you will have a strong passion for car sales in order to meet and exceed agreed targets for the sale of vehicles and related products.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@jacksons.je

Be aware of the commercial requirements of the company and the retail department in particular. Work to meet personal and group sales targets and process all orders within targets set by the Company. Key Skills and Experience: Previous sales experience. Appreciation of the importance of customer service. Ability to deal with difficult customers. Enthusiasm for new technology. Ability to deal with and communicate effectively with customers and staff at all levels. Knowledge of Microsoft Office. An understanding of modern retail technology would be desirable.

We’re looking for friendly, confident and enthusiastic people to join our Front of House team at Just Pizza & Pasta on North Quay, Douglas.
This is a customer facing role where personality matters. Once trained, you’ll be welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and drinks, clearing and resetting tables and helping make sure every customer leaves having enjoyed a great experience.
Various shifts are available, including daytime, evening and some weekend shifts, so there is flexibility depending on your availability.
We’re looking for people who are reliable, positive, comfortable working in a busy restaurant and genuinely enjoy dealing with customers. You’ll need to work well as part of a team and be willing to get stuck in when service gets busy.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you.

Notes
Be part of something precise, impactful, and innovative.
Are you someone who enjoys hands-on work, thrives in a laboratory environment, and takes pride in doing things with accuracy and care? We’re looking for a Production Technician to join our team and play a key role in manufacturing high-quality chromatography products that support important scientific and commercial outcomes.
This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.

What you’ll be doing - You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Your responsibilities will include: Manufacturing chromatography products, intermediates, and base materials, Following established SOPs and production methods with precision, Recording production data accurately and maintaining detailed documentation, Carrying out on-line quality control checks and identifying any anomalies early, Supporting process optimisation and improvement initiatives, Maintaining equipment and ensuring a clean, safe working environment
You’ll also contribute to: Improving processes and maximising yields, Writing and updating SOPs and production methods, Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of colleagues
We’re looking for someone who is practical, detail-focused, and proactive, with a genuine interest in laboratory-based manufacturing.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are: A strong team player with good communication skills, Highly organised with excellent attention to detail, Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, A natural problem solver who can spot issues early, Able to follow processes accurately while also contributing ideas for improvement
Desirable experience: A-levels or degree in a scientific discipline, Experience in regulated manufacturing (ideally chemical or similar environments) Familiarity with laboratory equipment and processes
This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role where no two days are quite the same. You can expect: A physically active role involving standing, lifting, and equipment operation, A structured environment with a strong focus on quality and safety, 24/7 shift patterns supporting continuous operations
You’ll be part of a collaborative team where your contribution directly impacts product quality, operational success, and continuous improvement. We value curiosity, precision, and teamwork — and we’re always looking for ways to do things better.
If you’re looking for a role where you can build your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and be part of a supportive and driven team, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply using the following link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8139650-production-chemist-astrea
